title: Molecular mechanism of the combined exposure to AFB1 and DON in promoting the functional and phenotypic remodeling of porcine alveolar macrophages.
authors: Zhao, Wenshuo; Yang, Qirui; Li, Shuxin; Sun, Yuhang
journal: Food and chemical toxicology : an international journal published for the British Industrial Biological Research Association
one_liner_zh: 该文研究AFB1和DON联合暴露对猪肺泡巨噬细胞免疫表型重塑的分子机制，虽含分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Aflatoxin B1 (AFB1) and deoxynivalenol (DON) often coexist and exhibit immunotoxicity. Recent studies have reported that AFB1 and DON exposure alone not only promoted immunosuppression, but also induced inflammation, demonstrating as bidirectional immunotoxicity. Nevertheless, whether the combination of AFB1 and DON exhibit bidirectional immunotoxicity and their mechanism remain unclear. Here, porcine alveolar macrophages were used as an in vitro model, and quantitative real-time PCR (qRT-PCR), Western blotting (WB), flow cytometry, network toxicology and molecular docking were used to investigate the bidirectional immunotoxicity and mechanism of AFB1 and DON combined contamination. Our results showed that the combined exposure of low concentrations of AFB1 and DON (0.005 + 0.5 mug/mL) induced macrophages polarizing to immunostimulatory M1 by upregulating the TLR4-NF-kappaB, while the combined exposure of high concentrations of AFB1 and DON (0.04 + 4 mug/mL) promoted macrophages polarizing to immunosuppressive M2 by downregulating the PI3K-AKT. The results will provide new insights for the in-depth study of the pathogenic mechanism of AFB1 and DON combined contamination.
abstract_zh: 黄曲霉毒素B1（AFB1）和脱氧雪腐镰刀菌烯醇（DON）常共存并表现出免疫毒性。近期研究报道，单独暴露于AFB1和DON不仅促进免疫抑制，还诱导炎症，表现为双向免疫毒性。然而，AFB1和DON联合暴露是否表现出双向免疫毒性及其机制仍不清楚。本研究以猪肺泡巨噬细胞为体外模型，采用实时荧光定量PCR（qRT-PCR）、Western blotting（WB）、流式细胞术、网络毒理学和分子对接技术，探讨AFB1和DON联合污染的双向免疫毒性及其机制。结果表明，低浓度AFB1和DON联合暴露（0.005 + 0.5 μg/mL）通过上调TLR4-NF-κB诱导巨噬细胞极化为免疫刺激型M1，而高浓度AFB1和DON联合暴露（0.04 + 4 μg/mL）通过下调PI3K-AKT促进巨噬细胞极化为免疫抑制型M2。这些结果将为深入研究AFB1和DON联合污染的致病机制提供新见解。
